title: Hôtel Regina Louvre Paris: Bourne Identity Hotel Guide
description: Hôtel Regina Louvre faces the Tuileries and appears in The Bourne Identity. Filming facts, history and tips for staying near the Louvre.
h1: Hôtel Regina Louvre: the Paris hotel from The Bourne Identity
intro: Facing the Tuileries Garden on Place des Pyramides, the Régina has been a Paris landmark since the 1900 World's Fair. It also turns up in several well-known thrillers.
filming: In The Bourne Identity (2002), the hotel is one of the Paris locations: Marie goes down to the lobby to carry out a plan she has worked out with Bourne. Wikipedia's list of the hotel's screen credits also includes La Femme Nikita (1990), Kiss of the Dragon (2001) and RED 2 (2013).
facts: The hotel opened in 1900 to coincide with the Paris World's Fair.
The Second Empire building was constructed in 1898-1900 by Léonard Tauber and Constant Baverez.
It stands across Rue de Rivoli from the Tuileries Garden, close to an entrance to the Louvre.
A gilded statue of Joan of Arc on horseback stands in the square in front of the hotel.
visit: The location is hard to beat for museum days, with the Louvre and the Tuileries both a few steps away. Look for the Joan of Arc statue outside, then step into the lobby to compare it with the film.
